classification.difficultyReason: Select between forward percentage change, reversing a multiplier and finding a signed percentage change across nine table rows.

inlines.text: Mr Brown bought parcels of shares in June last year. He has a spreadsheet showing the value at which he bought his shares, the value at 31 December last year, and the percentage increase or decrease in their value. (Decreases are shown with a negative sign.) Unfortunately, a virus has corrupted one entry in each row of his spreadsheet. Help him fix his spreadsheet by calculating the missing values, correct to two decimal places.

answer.worked:
The December value is $115\%$ of the purchase value.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Purchase value}&=80\,000\div1.15\\\text{Purchase value}&\approx\$69\,565.22\end{align*}$$

The December value is $358.3\%$ of the purchase value.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Purchase value}&=114\,262\div3.583\\\text{Purchase value}&\approx\$31\,890.04\end{align*}$$

The December value is $100\%-92.29\%=7.71\%$ of the purchase value.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Purchase value}&=32\,516.24\div0.0771\\\text{Purchase value}&\approx\$421\,741.12\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage change}&=\frac{40\,072.11}{48\,372.11}\times100\%-100\%\\\text{Percentage change}&\approx-17.16\%\end{align*}$$
The negative sign indicates a decrease.
